decisions.reason: Relocating the branded placard does not change the selected beige and green colors.
The customer-facing placard placement is owned by the branding Requirement and does not alter the DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The placard relocation does not change the spout geometry or barista-facing orientation; the independent spout decisions in the same message are already represented.
Placard placement does not affect bowl capacity, depth, or form.
The branding placement decision does not change the V1 sourcing policy or prototype-priority state.
Moving the placard does not affect the splash-control behavior.
The CAD and enclosure layout must incorporate the physical relocation of the named placard to the customer-facing front.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Please do this. Make it look as close as possible. I really like the look and functionality of the render. Also, one difference from the rendering. The plate on the back of the machine that reads "Karla's Matcha Mixer", place that on the front. The spout and the mixers would be in front of the baristas but the customer would see it from a different angle. I want "Karla's Matcha Mixer to face the customer.

value_updates.placard_placement_constraint: place the Karla's Matcha Mixer placard on the customer-facing front of the machine
